mechanism_MEASURED.cause: Aggregation is 4x Conv3d(3,3,3,padding=1)+LeakyReLU then Conv3d(32->1,3,3,3,padding=1). The 3x3x3 kernel spans the DISPARITY axis with zero padding, so identical input slices do NOT give identical output slices. Five stacked conv layers propagate the D-axis boundary effect five candidates inward from each end; with D=12 that reaches essentially the whole volume.
mechanism_MEASURED.consequence: a provably degenerate cost volume still yields a structured, input-dependent candidate curve. 'response != 0' is therefore NOT evidence of correspondence.
